# CANDIDATE: RELAX_RIBBON_SPREAD_FILTER_BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON_20C

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Relaxing the ribbon spread filter from >=30c to >=20c will capture additional bearish rejection setups that were previously filtered out due to a too-tight ribbon spread requirement, thereby increasing the number of valid trades and improving edge capture on J winner days without increasing losses on J loser days.

## Mechanism

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup currently requires the EMA ribbon spread (Fast EMA to Slow EMA) to be at least 30 cents. We relax this to 20 cents, allowing entries in conditions where the ribbon is less compressed but still bearish. Entry trigger remains: level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, and confluence with multi-day or premarket structure (at least two of three). Exit logic remains: chart stop (primary), chandelier profit-lock (arms at +5%, trails 0.15), and premium stop as catastrophe cap (-50%).
